Tests epoch rewards sysvar decode size and alignment bounds.

# Purpose
This file contains a small C test case for the `fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards` data type and its binary decode support. The function [`test_sysvar_epoch_rewards_bounds`](<#test_sysvar_epoch_rewards_bounds>) uses a fixed on-chain byte array and checks that its size matches `FD_SYSVAR_EPOCH_REWARDS_BINCODE_SZ`, that `fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_decode_footprint` returns `FD_BINCODE_SUCCESS`, and that the decoded object size matches `FD_SYSVAR_EPOCH_REWARDS_FOOTPRINT`. It also verifies that `fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_align()` returns `FD_SYSVAR_EPOCH_REWARDS_ALIGN`. The [`test_sysvar_epoch_rewards`](<#test_sysvar_epoch_rewards>) wrapper runs the bounds test and leaves a placeholder for more test cases.
